title: Encryption Key Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the encryption key management policy. Enforces: only approved algorithms (AES-256, RSA-2048+, ChaCha20-Poly1305), minimum key lengths, no key reuse across purposes, both transit and storage covered, and rotation interval within bounds.

error_codes.EK001: encryption-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: keys[], algorithms[], rotation
error_codes.EK002: Unapproved encryption algorithm used — allowed: AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, RSA-2048+, ECDSA P-256+
error_codes.EK003: Key length below minimum — AES must be ≥256-bit, RSA must be ≥2048-bit
error_codes.EK004: Same key used for multiple purposes (e.g., signing and encryption) — use separate keys per purpose
error_codes.EK005: Encryption policy does not cover both transit (TLS) and storage (at-rest) — both are required
error_codes.EK006: Key rotation interval exceeds 365 days or is not defined — rotate keys at least annually
